parts:
Critical discussion of formative measurement models can be found in the
following two sources.

Edwards, J. R. (2010). The fallacy of formative measurement.
Organizational Research Methods, 14, 370-388.
Markus, K. A. & Borsboom, D. (2013). Frontiers of test validity
theory: measurement, causation and meaning. New York: Routledge.
(Chapter 8).

Keith
